name: Iconium
line: Iconium was a large, rich city in Lycaonia where Paul and Barnabas preached, many people believed, and the two men fled a plot to stone them.

moments.title: Arriving in Iconium
moments.text: After they were pushed out of their district, Paul and Barnabas shook the dust off their feet and went to Iconium.

moments.title: Preaching in the synagogue
moments.text: Paul and Barnabas spoke so well in the Jewish synagogue that a great number of Jews and Greeks believed. They stayed a long time, speaking boldly as the Lord gave them power to do signs and wonders.

moments.title: Returning to Iconium
moments.text: After preaching in Derbe, Paul and Barnabas went back through Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch. They strengthened the believers and chose elders for each church.

moments.title: Timothy's good name
moments.text: The brothers in Lystra and Iconium spoke well of Timothy, a disciple Paul wanted to take along with him.
